name: Hash Plant
summary: **Hash Plant** is a [[kind:cut|clone-only]] selection of [[afghani|Afghani]] stock that was developed in the Pacific Northwest of the United States and carried to the Netherlands as cuttings in the early 1980s. [[breeder:Sensi Seeds|Sensi Seeds]] maintained and distributed it, and a stabilized seed line placed third in the Hydro category at the 2002 Highlife Cup.
